journal_lines: Tide pools at the base of the cliffs. The hunter took what swam. The miner took what the water left behind.
Low tide exposed the rock shelf. Copper-tinged stone and small fish. Both worth taking.
Rocky shoreline. Good place for two roles that know what they're looking at.
The water pulls back and shows you everything. Ore and fish. Took both.
Crabs in the pools, copper in the wet rock above. Two kinds of patience required.
The tide had laid out the morning's work in small bright squares.
Smelled like seaweed and old iron. Two good smells, together.
Worked the pools until the tide returned. The tide returns punctually. Came home with both bags full.
